section_model.same_page_refinement: distinct trusted heading-anchor geometry for every candidate section

grouping_rules: TOC-page content is explicitly excluded from financial sections.
A single reliable page range assigns content directly.
Overlapping same-page ranges require trusted, distinct anchors for all candidate sections.
An exact heading source reference belongs to its matching section.
A multi-page item is assigned only when exactly one candidate section exists and fully contains every page.
Nested or intersecting multi-page candidates remain ambiguous with all candidate section IDs.
Tables spanning sections remain ambiguous while independently located cells/rows may be assigned.
Missing page provenance and content outside reliable ranges remain explicitly unassigned.

conservation_invariant.equation: inventory = assigned union ambiguous union unassigned
